title: fix(api-proxy): skip Responses custom-tool translation on Chat Completions routes
author: copilot-swe-agent
head: 799835f22752e22524826077311c9b4b7a3149dd
body:
`transformRequestBody()` ran `translateCodexCustomToolsForCopilot()` on every writable Copilot request, including `/chat/completions`. That translator handles the Responses custom-tool dialect. When it saw a Chat Completions custom tool (`{ type: 'custom', custom: { name } }`), it read the name as missing and rejected the request:

```text
Unsupported Responses custom tool '(unknown)'. Only 'apply_patch' is supported through the Copilot compatibility adapter.
```

### Changes

- **Route guard (`containers/api-proxy/body-handler.js`)**
  - New `isChatCompletionsRequest(url)` helper. It strips the query string, `#` fragment and trailing slashes, then matches on the `/chat/completions` suffix.
  - Copilot requests on those routes now skip the Codex custom-tool translation. The body is forwarded unchanged and `codexCompatibility` stays `null`.
  - Requests on other routes, including `/responses` and `/v1/responses`, behave as before: `apply_patch` is translated and any other custom tool is rejected.
- **Regression tests (`containers/api-proxy/body-handler.test.js`)**
  - Chat Completions custom tools pass through unchanged on `/chat/completions`, `/v1/chat/completions` and `/chat/completions/?x=1`.
  - `apply_patch` on `/responses` is still translated to the function-tool form.
  - An unsupported custom tool on `/v1/responses` still throws `CodexCompatibilityError`.

### Review focus

The guard matches any path ending in `/chat/completions`, including prefixed forms like `/openai/v1/chat/completions`. This is intentionally broader than a fixed list of prefixes, and it follows the same suffix-matching approach as `isInferenceRequest` in `upstream-log.js`.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- Fixes #9057

adjudication.reason: the check fails the same way on the base and the head, so it did not discriminate between them
adjudication.requirement: Chat Completions requests (URLs ending in /chat/completions) must skip the Codex custom-tool translation, passing the body through unchanged with codexCompatibility=null. Before this fix, translateCodexCustomToolsForCopilot was called on all writable Copilot requests including Chat Completions routes, causing it to reject valid Chat Completions custom tools with "Unsupported Responses custom tool '(unknown)'".
